entries.title: Build a Reusable Card with Props
entries.matchText: Build a Reusable Card with Props Foundations a reusable typed component combines one JSX structure with a checked props contract. Create a three-property props interface and a card component that applies it, displays every prop, and is rendered three times with different values.

entries.title: Compose a page from reusable components
entries.matchText: Compose a page from reusable components Foundations component composition builds larger interfaces by nesting and arranging smaller components. Create at least three focused child components and one page component that renders all three in semantic regions. Pass at least one value from the page into a child.

entries.title: Model local UI state
entries.matchText: Model local UI state Foundations local UI state is component-owned information that can change through interaction and affect rendering. Create a component with a boolean open state and a typed selectedId state that permits one string id or null. Derive `hasSelection` from selectedId and render content for both questions.

entries.title: Handle typed user events
entries.matchText: Handle typed user events Foundations a typed React event describes the event API and currentTarget element available to the handler. Create a component with a controlled input and form. Use a named typed change handler and a named typed submit handler that prevents default submission.

entries.title: Render idle, loading, success, empty, and error states
entries.matchText: Render idle, loading, success, empty, and error states Foundations an async UI state model identifies the current operation stage and carries stage-specific data. Create a discriminated union for idle, loading, success with a typed data array, and error with a message. Create a component that renders every status and distinguishes empty from populated success.

entries.title: Application shell and layout wrapper
entries.matchText: Application shell and layout wrapper Navigation & Layout an application shell is the persistent header, navigation, and content structure shared by a set of pages. Create a typed AppShell receiving children. Render a header, nav with at least two links, and one main region containing children.

entries.title: Responsive shell with header, sidebar, and main region
entries.matchText: Responsive shell with header, sidebar, and main region Navigation & Layout a responsive shell rearranges the same meaningful regions according to available space. Create shell JSX with header, aside navigation, and main. Add CSS that uses one column by default and at least two columns above a breakpoint.

entries.title: Accessible sidebar and navigation drawer
entries.matchText: Accessible sidebar and navigation drawer Navigation & Layout a navigation drawer is a conditionally visible navigation region controlled by an explicit button. Create a component with boolean drawer state, a button using aria-expanded and aria-controls, and a nav with the matching id. Close it when Escape is pressed.

entries.title: Route configuration and navigation links
entries.matchText: Route configuration and navigation links Navigation & Layout a route associates a URL pattern with the interface rendered for that location. Create at least three route objects with distinct paths and elements. Create navigation with three Link components whose to values match those paths.

entries.title: Nested routes and shared layouts
entries.matchText: Nested routes and shared layouts Navigation & Layout a nested route renders its child inside the matched parent route's outlet. Create a parent route object with an element and at least three child route objects. Create the parent layout component with navigation and Outlet.

entries.title: Detail routes with URL parameters
entries.matchText: Detail routes with URL parameters Navigation & Layout a route parameter is a named changing segment captured from a matched path. Create a route object with a named id parameter and a detail component that reads that exact parameter, handles its missing case, and displays or uses it.

entries.title: Route-aware breadcrumbs
entries.matchText: Route-aware breadcrumbs Navigation & Layout breadcrumbs show the current page's position in a navigable hierarchy. Create a typed breadcrumb component accepting at least three items. Render nav with aria-label, an ordered list, links for non-current items, and aria-current page on the final item.

entries.title: Keyboard-accessible tabs
entries.matchText: Keyboard-accessible tabs Navigation & Layout an accessible tab widget is a coordinated set of tabs and associated panels with a defined keyboard model. Create a three-tab component with active index state, tablist/tab/tabpanel roles, aria-selected and matching aria-controls/panel ids, plus wrapping ArrowLeft and ArrowRight handling.

entries.title: Nested menus and dropdown navigation
entries.matchText: Nested menus and dropdown navigation Navigation & Layout a menu button opens a set of related choices using an explicit keyboard and focus pattern. Create a menu button with boolean state, aria-expanded/controls, a controlled menu id containing at least three links or menuitems, and a key handler for Escape plus ArrowDown.

entries.title: Global command palette and keyboard shortcuts
entries.matchText: Global command palette and keyboard shortcuts Navigation & Layout a command palette is an application-level searchable list of named navigation and action commands. Create typed command data with at least three commands, open state and query state, filtered results, a Ctrl/Cmd+K key condition, ArrowDown active movement, Enter execution, and Escape closing.

entries.title: Warn before abandoning unsaved work
entries.matchText: Warn before abandoning unsaved work Navigation & Layout an unsaved-work guard intercepts navigation only when leaving would discard changes. Create baseline and current typed form values, derive isDirty without another state, register a beforeunload effect only when dirty with cleanup, and show a confirmation dialog state for blocked internal navigation.

entries.title: Reusable information and summary cards
entries.matchText: Reusable information and summary cards Data Display an information card is a compact semantic component summarizing one related group of information. Create a typed SummaryCard with label string, value ReactNode, and optional description. Render an article with heading and conditional description, then show three cards with different values.

entries.title: Typed list with keys and empty state
entries.matchText: Typed list with keys and empty state Data Display a data list is a component whose rendered items derive from a collection prop. Create a typed list component accepting object items with id and at least one display property. Show a helpful empty message or map semantic list items keyed by id.

entries.title: Master-detail selection flow
entries.matchText: Master-detail selection flow Data Display a master–detail flow shows a collection and one currently selected record's details. Create typed items, `string | null` selectedId state, derive selected item with find, render selectable buttons, and show either selection guidance or the selected details.

entries.title: Semantic responsive data table
entries.matchText: Semantic responsive data table Data Display a semantic data table expresses relationships between column headings and record values. Create a typed table component with caption, at least three scoped column headers, mapped keyed rows, and one colSpan empty row when data is empty.

entries.title: Recursive tree view

entries.title: Kanban board with typed columns
entries.matchText: Kanban board with typed columns Data Display a Kanban board is a grouped view of items whose workflow status determines their column. Create a three-choice status union, typed item array state, column definitions, filtered rendering by status, and a move function using map and object spread to update one item's status.

entries.title: Dashboard composition and derived metrics
entries.matchText: Dashboard composition and derived metrics Data Display a dashboard summarizes current source data into actionable views and metrics. Create a typed record-array dashboard that derives at least three distinct metrics using length/filter/reduce and passes them into reusable summary cards. Use no useEffect for metric synchronization.

Create a typed Chart component that handles loading and empty data, renders a figure with figcaption and labeled chart region, and includes a table or list containing every data label and value.
